content.short: Atlas is a peer-to-peer protocol for decentralized identity and discovery, enabling users to maintain ownership of their reputation across applications.
content.description: Atlas Protocol is an open-layer infrastructure designed to solve the issues of internet centralization by separating identity from application data. It provides a foundational layer for decentralized discovery, trust, and governance, allowing users to carry their reputation and data across multiple interoperable platforms. On the Mantle Network, Atlas serves as a key piece of infrastructure for building user-centric dApps that prioritize data sovereignty and cross-chain interoperability.
